summary: B-controls fixer. The live major is fixed at its root cause. Repeat turned on while an item plays did not loop the item. VLC's playlist picks the player's next media when an item starts, when the queue changes, or when the stop action is set. It does not do this when repeat or order changes (src/playlist/control.c). The single queued item therefore ended as if Repeat were off. The bridge's playlist listener now sets the unchanged stop action again on every repeat or order change, under the playlist lock. That public call makes the core pick the next media again, and it covers every path (queue commands, the Repeat setting, a VLC hotkey). A new bridge-smoke check covers it: one-item queue, Repeat All and then Repeat One turned on mid-item, seek near the end, expect the item to start again. Before the fix it fails with 'state 0' (stopped), both in the tree and in an isolated copy with the fix reverted; after the fix it passes. The headless dummy-interface probe confirmed the engine itself loops with --loop and --repeat. The pending arrow OSD slot is fixed too. Only an arrow the core will turn into a jump waits for a report: no changeable 360° viewpoint, and the title is not a menu or interactive (DVD/Blu-ray). A report in the wrong direction (for example an A-B loop's jump back) no longer takes the slot. A bridge-smoke check covers this; it fails without the fix. Critic P2: the music bar is now the tint over its own backdrop with no NSVisualEffectView material. The bar went from #191919 to #18 against Figma #171717 (Δ1). S34 flat colour dropped from 6.04 % to 3.91 % (Player/music), from 6.43 % to 3.92 % (music-waveform) and from 6.62 % to 4.11 % (App/music). What remains is the artwork backdrop (#1B vs #1D), not the bar. D056 is amended to say fixed, with MusicBarTintTests, which fails without the fix. Parity S01 hover: Play is now Accent/DIm under the pointer, as the video's hovered accent button reads; Pause keeps the iconHover tile. The test is updated and fails without the fix, and D056 is amended. A-window had already made Continue hover Accent/Dim, so the accent buttons now agree. PlayerMenus: D-menus had already replaced .plain with MXRBarButtonStyle, so the press dimming is gone. I added the missing Icon Wrapper hover tile to the speed, HDR and zoom menus and the compact '⋯' (MXRBarHoverTile, with a test). Player - Light gear: recorded in D049. Figma's partial conversion also leaves the previous/next arrows in Dark/FG/A2, while the other bar icons use Light/FG/A2 #2E2E2E. Running mxr-snapshot check --all gives PASS 31 · REVIEW 78 · FAIL 10, and no entry got worse than the integration baseline. One regression I introduced and fixed along the way: a forced env true made S01.ControlBar/default draw the material.
fixed: (e)/(a) LIVE MAJOR, Repeat does not loop a single item: root cause in the core's next-media selection (vlc_playlist_SetPlaybackRepeat/Order never call vlc_playlist_UpdateNextMedia). Fix in MXRServicesBridge.m: QueueRepeat/QueueOrder call -refreshNextMedia:, which re-sets the playlist's own stop action (tracked under the playlist lock via QueueStopAction; -1 until the listener's initial state). bridge-smoke: 'repeat mode N turned on mid-item restarts the only queue item at its end'. Before: ../build/evidence/final6/fix/B-controls/native-fixture-before.log ('FAIL: repeat mode 2 ... (state 0)'). Isolated revert: native-fixture-revert.log (same FAIL). After: native-fixture-after.log (PASS: fixture). The UI already shows the state: menu .on/.mixed, ⋯ 'Repeat All/One', active queue and bar icon.

(e) Arrow pending OSD slot (verify open[2]): an arrow adds a slot only when ArrowWillJump. That means no vout with viewpoint-changeable, and a selected title without VLC_PLAYER_TITLE_MENU or VLC_PLAYER_TITLE_INTERACTIVE, the same rule the core uses in vlc_player_input_NavigationFallback. Slots are a FIFO of {direction, time at the key, 1 s deadline}. Expired slots drop, and a report the other way (A-B loop back) is not taken. bridge-smoke: 'a seek back is not shown as a right arrow's target' plus an 'arrow still shows its own target' check. Fails without the fix: native-fixture-revert-arrow.log; passes: native-fixture-after.log.

(b)/(d) Critic P2 D056 music-bar tint: the dark music bar (audio-only, not customizing, not beside the picture) draws BG/A3 Transparent over its own blurred artwork or black canvas, without the material. Bar #191919 -> #181818 (Figma #171717). S34.Player/music flat colour 6.04 % -> 3.91 %, music-waveform 6.43 % -> 3.92 %, App/music 6.62 % -> 4.11 %; the bar regions are gone. Evidence: s34-after/player_music_bar_right_cmp.png, s34-after/*/report.txt. Test MusicBarTintTests fails without the fix (reads 25,25,25: pkg-revert-tests.log). D056 amended.

(c) Parity S01 hover: Play hover is Accent/DIm (#AB6314; Light #965916) per video 14m09.8 and spec-part2. Pause keeps the iconHover tile. Test testPlayHoverIsAccentDimAndPauseHoverAddsTheBarHoverTile fails without the fix (214 vs 171: pkg-revert-tests.log). D056 amended. Continue was already Accent/Dim on hover (A-window), so the accent buttons are consistent.

(e)/(b) PlayerMenus speed/HDR/zoom menus and compact ⋯: the press dimming was already removed by D-menus (MXRBarButtonStyle). I added the bar hover state they lacked (MXRBarHoverTile: iconHover tile, glyph unchanged, none when disabled or in Customize). Test testBarMenuButtonsShowTheBarHoverTile. It is a new modifier, so the test cannot run without it.

(e)/(b)/(d) Player - Light gear Dark/FG/A2: recorded as a D049 amendment, which also notes that Figma's prev/next arrows carry Dark/FG/A2 while the other bar icons use Light/FG/A2 #2E2E2E (verified in figma_file.json fills and strokes).

Neighbour checks: S01.ControlBar/default PASS, S01.Window/shipping PASS, C.PlayButton/play PASS, C.SeekBar/default PASS, S72.Window/light REVIEW (was FAIL). The --all run gives PASS 31 · REVIEW 78 · FAIL 10, with no entry worse than ../build/evidence/final5/polish/integration/check-all.log (checkall.log).

notesForOthers: Integrator: the Repeat fix and the arrow-slot change are in MXRServicesBridge.m, so they need the make/install build. Run the native fixture suite (bridge-smoke has two new checks). C-bridge: I made the backend part of the Repeat fix myself (refreshNextMedia in the queue listener); please don't add a second refresh. Not changed, worth a look: AppModel's player.endOfItemHook sets the stop action to .continue when the 'end of item' sleep timer ends or is cancelled. That overwrites a user's 'Stop after each item' or 'Quit VLC' setting and clears play-and-pause; it should restore the previous action. AppGallery owner: S34.App/music lacks the D028 waveform deviation that S34.Player/music carries, so its seek bar region (render solid bar vs Figma waveform at 332,1040) counts as a difference. H-design: the mxrNativeBackdropEnabled doc says it is for fixtures only; the music control bar now uses it (false) on purpose (D056).
